sections.title: Islands
sections.note: Every island you can land on. The four Sea Charts themselves are in the Main Quest.

items.name: Mercay Island
items.howTo: Where you wash up, with Mercay Village, the Shipyard and the Temple of the Ocean King.

items.name: Isle of Ember
items.howTo: In the south-east of the Southwestern Sea; Astrid's house and the Temple of Fire.

items.name: Cannon Island
items.howTo: Just south-west of Mercay Island; Eddo's garage and the Bomb Garden.

items.name: Molida Island
items.howTo: In the west of the Southwestern Sea, past the dark rocks the Cannon breaks.

items.name: Spirit Island
items.howTo: Hidden in the triangle of rocks south of Molida Island (a Boing Statue on Molida hints at it); it's charted once Ciela spots it.

items.name: Isle of Gust
items.howTo: In the middle of the Northwestern Sea, past the fog; the Temple of Wind.

items.name: Zauz's Island
items.howTo: Hidden at the north edge of the Northwestern Sea, its middle; the Old Wayfarer's map in the Isle of Gust's Cavern Study marks it.

items.name: Uncharted Island
items.howTo: Hidden by the diagonal rock wall on the east edge, north-east of the Isle of Gust. It has no map: walk its coast and draw it yourself.

items.name: Bannan Island
items.howTo: In the north-east of the Northwestern Sea; the Old Wayfarer and Salvatore's Cannon Game.

items.name: Goron Island
items.howTo: In the Southeastern Sea; the Goron Temple.

items.name: Isle of Frost
items.howTo: In the Southeastern Sea; shoot down its ice walls to dock. The Temple of Ice.

items.name: Dee Ess Island
items.howTo: Hidden in the south of the Southeastern Sea; shaped like a Nintendo DS. The Goron Game.

items.name: Harrow Island
items.howTo: Hidden north of a triangle of rocks in the north-west of the Southeastern Sea; a Yook on the Isle of Frost tells you after the Temple of Ice. The Digging Game.

items.name: Isle of the Dead
items.howTo: In the Northeastern Sea; shaped like a king's head.

items.name: Isle of Ruins
items.howTo: In the Northeastern Sea, behind a cyclone the Regal Necklace calms; Mutoh's Temple.

items.name: Maze Island
items.howTo: In the north of the Northeastern Sea; the Treasure Maze.

sections.title: Golden Frogs
sections.note: Six frogs, one warp each, once you have the Cyclone Slate from Uncharted Island.

items.name: Golden Frog south of Mercay
items.howTo: Leaping in the sea south of Mercay Island. Hit it with the Cannon; it shows the symbol to draw on the Cyclone Slate.

items.name: Golden Frog north of Molida
items.howTo: Leaping in the sea north of Molida Island. Hit it with the Cannon; it shows the symbol to draw on the Cyclone Slate.

items.name: Golden Frog between Bannan and Gust
items.howTo: Leaping between Bannan Island and the Isle of Gust. Hit it with the Cannon; it shows the symbol to draw on the Cyclone Slate.

items.name: Golden Frog north of Dee Ess
items.howTo: Leaping north of Dee Ess Island. Hit it with the Cannon; it shows the symbol to draw on the Cyclone Slate.

items.name: Golden Frog north-west of Frost
items.howTo: Leaping north-west of the Isle of Frost. Hit it with the Cannon; it shows the symbol to draw on the Cyclone Slate.

items.name: Golden Frog south of the Isle of the Dead
items.howTo: Leaping south of the Isle of the Dead. Hit it with the Cannon; it shows the symbol to draw on the Cyclone Slate.
